title: Do This Before GTA 6 Unlocks
yt_title: Do These 4 Things Before GTA 6 Unlocks Tonight ✅ #shorts
description:
GTA 6 unlocks at midnight in India. Quick checklist: preload, free up storage, update your console and charge your controller.

#GTA6 #GTAVI #GTA6Launch

lines.text: Do these four things before GTA 6 unlocks tonight.
One, preload it now, the preload is already open.
Two, clear storage on your console, this game is huge.
Three, update your PS5 or Xbox so nothing stops you at midnight.
Four, charge your controller, you won't want to stop.
Then at twelve, Leonida is yours.
What's the first thing you'll do in GTA 6?
